This is a general SEM question, not a lavaan question. You could try asking this question on semnet, a list devoted to structural equation modeling generally.
     You can find discussion of fit assessment in factor-based SEM in standard texts, like Rex Kline's. Using general criteria, this is not a good model for these data. Authorities would recommend that you screen out this model in favor of competing models. Modification indices would point you to areas where you could improve the fit of this model, on a purely data-driven, theory-free basis.
